name: Ai
overview: Ai was a significant Canaanite city known for its royal status and its conquest by Israel, where twelve thousand men and women were slain as recorded in Joshua 8:25. The city is also referenced under the names Aija and Aiath, indicating its historical and geographical importance (Nehemiah 11:31; Isaiah 10:28). Its population and presence are noted in post-exilic records, such as Ezra 2:28, affirming its continued habitation. Additionally, Ai is mentioned in the context of Ammonite cities and their judgment, emphasizing its role in the broader biblical narrative of divine sovereignty and judgment (Jeremiah 49:3).
